# earthquery

earthquery turns plain English into vector search over satellite imagery embeddings.
Ask "solar farms in deserts" and get matching locations on a map, ranked by embedding similarity.

## Status: demo index (v1)

v1 searches a bundled demo index of 521 tiles (Southern Ontario grid plus 22
world-region anchors) with deterministic 64-dim concept vectors. These are NOT
real satellite measurements. The pipeline (query -> embedding -> cosine search
-> ranked tiles) is real and provider-agnostic. Production design: EmbeddingGemma 2
(Apache 2.0) for queries, AlphaEarth Satellite Embedding V1 (CC-BY 4.0, Google
Earth Engine dataset GOOGLE_SATELLITE_EMBEDDING_V1_ANNUAL) for tiles.
Never present demo results as satellite analysis.

## Search modes

- Keyword (default): the query is mapped to land-use concepts via a deterministic
  keyword/phrase table (lib/providers.ts), then cosine-ranked. No key needed.
- Place-aware: "<thing> in <place>" queries are filtered to the named region
  (lib/places.ts gazetteer: Africa, Europe, Asia, North America, South America,
  Oceania, Sahara, Amazon, Middle East). Places with no demo coverage return an
  honest empty result with a `notice` string.
- AI search (bring your own key): the header toggle lets a visitor paste a
  Hugging Face token, stored only in their browser's localStorage. The query is
  embedded in-browser with the EmbeddingGemma 2 model
  (google/embeddinggemma-2) via the Hugging Face Inference API; tile vectors
  are rebuilt from their tags' concept embeddings in the same space. The key
  never touches our servers.

## API (no key in v1)

- GET /api/search?q=solar+farms+in+deserts&limit=12
  Returns { query, provider, dimensions, tile_count, matched_concepts,
  matched_places, notice, demo, results }.
  Each result: { tile_id, bbox: [south, west, north, east], center: [lat, lng],
  score: 0-100, tags }. HTTP 400 when q is missing. Empty results array when the
  query matches no known concepts, or when a named place has no demo coverage
  (then `notice` explains why).
- GET /api/health
  Returns { status, version, provider, dimensions, tiles, coverage, demo }.
- GET /llms.txt (this file)

## Configuration

No environment variables or keys are required to run the demo. Optional:
a visitor's Hugging Face token is entered in the browser (AI search toggle) and
stored in localStorage; the production server-side adapter uses HF_TOKEN.
See README "Configuration".

## Examples

curl "https://earthquery-mauve.vercel.app/api/search?q=container+ports&limit=5"
curl "https://earthquery-mauve.vercel.app/api/health"
